title: scene.nodeAdded (publisher → relay → viewers)
description: Hint that a snapshot containing these new nodes follows; v1 has no per-node GLB delta, so snapshotFollows is always true and a scene.snapshot.begin with a higher sceneVersion MUST come next (docs/protocol.md §8.2). Viewers MAY ignore it.

nodes.description: Ids and kinds of the nodes the next snapshot will add; never names (§7, §8.3). 1..1000 per message: a schema-defined cap (§14) mirroring the §3.3 maximum for scene.update.changes.

not.$comment: §7/§8.3: the JSON protocol never carries node names (PHI); the GLB does.

snapshotFollows.description: Always true in v1.0; a per-node GLB in v1.1 would set it to false (§8.2, §14).
